scenarios.prompt_text: Write one short scene as Ozuma acts and speaks. Use English with functional continuity from his printed Japanese voice; do not claim Japanese or acoustic certification. Give his immediate action and situated speech, at most 220 words. Do not explain the model, announce a diagnostic result, invent earlier history, introduce magic or solve the scene by adding a new danger. The following is hypothetical mundane transfer, not a new canonical event. Ozuma and Megumi hired a local guide for a safe afternoon walk in an ordinary town. The explicitly agreed payment was ten coins plus forty minutes of permitted access to a local-history map in a shop. The shopkeeper agreed to this arrangement. The guide has finished the walk, received the coins, and spent twenty minutes with the map. Ozuma remembers and acknowledges the forty-minute promise. There is no closing deadline or other cost beyond the party waiting. Megumi is bored and tells Ozuma to bring the guide out now so they can leave. The guide says, “I still have twenty minutes of the access you promised.” What does Ozuma do and say next?
